headline: KenGen Appoints John Mosonik Board Chairman
summary: Kenya Electricity Generating Company has appointed John Kipngetich Mosonik as its new board chairman, replacing outgoing chair Alfred Agoui.
why: Board leadership changes at major state-linked utilities can signal shifts in corporate governance and strategic direction.

impacts.name: KenGen
impacts.why: New leadership introduces changes to company oversight and operational management.
